evidence: ref27/System/Applications/Weather.app/Contents/Info.plist via bifrost pc ref extract (URL scheme weather, user activities WeatherIntent; NSLocationUsageDescription for local weather and notifications near you)

ref27/System/Applications/Weather.app/Contents/Resources: weather-material.materialrecipe, weather-material-alternate.materialrecipe (window material only; the app binary is in the shared cache and its UI resources ship in private frameworks, so the feature list also follows the shipped app's documented behaviour)
springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/ and springboard/src/shell/weather/ (data.rs forecast query, glyph.rs)

features.apple: Source list of saved places, each with a live temperature and condition
features.note: Each sidebar row shows the place's last known temperature on the right; no condition glyph in the row yet (SidebarItem has no icon slot for a drawn glyph).
features.wire: Store each place's last Summary (data.rs:271) and draw its temperature and condition glyph on the right of the row in weather.rs side_rows (weather.rs:391), using shell::weather::glyph.

features.apple: Search field finds a city and adds it to the list
features.note: Sidebar search opens the Locations page with a focused field; results add a place.

features.apple: Delete from the list (Edit > Delete, swipe, context menu)
features.note: Delete or Backspace removes the selected place from the main page (code 46 mapped in main.rs). The sidebar secondary-click menu is still missing.
features.wire: Handle the Delete key in weather.rs key() (weather.rs:933) for the selected sidebar row and add a secondary-click menu with Remove.

features.apple: Drag rows to reorder the list
features.note: Places keep the order they were added.
features.wire: Add drag handling to the sidebar source_list rows in weather.rs touch() (weather.rs:973) and persist the order in data::Store (data.rs:358).

features.apple: First entry follows the device location and asks for permission (NSLocationUsageDescription)
features.note: The shell gives apps no location service yet; the authorization is fixed at NotDetermined and the Locations note says so.
features.wire: When the shell exposes a location service, replace the LOCATION constant (weather.rs:108) by a request through bifrost_app::controls::location, insert a My Location place first and refresh it on movement; insights::location_note (insights.rs:163) already words the states.

features.apple: Large temperature, condition, high and low for the place
features.note: Big temperature, condition glyph and name, high and low.

features.apple: Scrolling strip of hours with temperature, condition and precipitation chance
features.note: Precipitation chance under each hour's glyph (rounded to 5, hidden below 10). Sunrise and sunset markers between the hours are still missing.
features.wire: Add precipitation_probability and the day's sunrise and sunset to the hourly query (data.rs:243) and draw the percentage under the glyph and sun markers between the hours in weather.rs:1154.

features.apple: Ten days with condition, range bar against the period's range, precipitation chance
features.note: Range bar already scaled to the ten-day extremes; the daily precipitation chance is now under each day's glyph.
features.wire: Draw a min-max range bar per day scaled to the ten-day extremes in weather.rs:1173 and add precipitation_probability_max to the daily query (data.rs:243).

features.apple: Next-hour precipitation chart with a summary sentence
features.note: Next Hour card above the hourly strip: summary sentence and four quarter-hour bars from minutely_15 precipitation (details.rs next_hour_summary, next_hour_bars). Quarter-hour resolution, not per minute.
features.wire: Request minutely_15 precipitation in forecast_url (data.rs:243), add Forecast.minutes in data.rs:169 and draw a Next Hour card above the hourly strip.

features.apple: Window background and materials follow sky and time of day
features.note: Gradient backdrop by sky and day or night.

features.apple: UV Index with level word and advice
features.note: Value and level note.

features.apple: Sunrise with sunset in the footer, path of the sun
features.note: Sun path arc with the sun at its position between sunrise and sunset.
features.wire: Draw the day arc with the sun position from the two times in weather.rs:1214.

features.apple: Wind speed, gusts and direction compass
features.note: Note gives the compass point and gusts; a dotted compass dial marks the direction the wind comes from. No arrow needle or tick labels besides N.
features.wire: Add wind_direction_10m and wind_gusts_10m to the current query (data.rs:243), extend data::Current (data.rs:136) and draw a compass dial in the tile.

features.apple: Humidity with dew point
features.note: Note shows the dew point in the temperature unit.
features.wire: Add dew_point_2m to the current query (data.rs:243) and show it as the tile note.

features.apple: Apparent temperature with a note why
features.note: Value with a note comparing it to the real temperature.

features.apple: Moon phase and illumination
features.note: Illumination share and phase name computed locally.

features.apple: Rain or snow amount for 24 hours and the next days
features.note: Next 24 hours total with tomorrow's amount as the note, mm or in following the unit setting. Snow is not separated from rain.
features.wire: Add precipitation_sum to the daily and precipitation to the hourly query (data.rs:243), a Precipitation tile in weather.rs:1212 and mm or in following the unit setting.

features.apple: Visibility distance with a note
features.note: Visibility in km or mi from the hourly series with a descriptive note.
features.wire: Add visibility to the hourly query (data.rs:243) and a Visibility tile in weather.rs:1212 with km or mi.

features.apple: Barometric pressure with a trend dial
features.note: hPa or inHg with a Rising, Falling or Steady note from the three-hour change. No trend dial.
features.wire: Add pressure_msl to the current query (data.rs:243) and a Pressure tile in weather.rs:1212 with hPa or inHg and a rising or falling note.

features.apple: Air Quality index card with level and main pollutant
features.note: No air quality source.
features.wire: Query the air-quality endpoint of the forecast service (european_aqi, pm2_5) in data.rs, add Forecast.air and an Air Quality card after the tiles in weather.rs:1212.

features.apple: Today's high against the average high for the date
features.note: No climate data.
features.wire: Fetch the archive daily maximum for the same date over the last ten years (data.rs) and add an Averages tile that states the difference.

features.apple: Interactive temperature line over the day
features.note: Line with area fill, labelled axis and times.

features.apple: Precipitation, Temperature and Air Quality map overlays with a Map button in the toolbar
features.note: The Map card is a latitude and longitude grid with a scale bar and says no tiles are loaded.
features.wire: Use bifrost-maps (springboard/apps/maps-desktop tiles, cache, source) to draw base tiles under the card and add radar overlay tiles from a configurable raster layer URL with a layer switch (Precipitation, Temperature, Air Quality) in the toolbar.

features.apple: Alert banner with region and threat level, full alert text
features.note: DATA_HAS_ALERTS is false; the footer says alerts are not available.
features.wire: Choose an alert feed (national warning service CAP feed for the place) in data.rs, add Forecast.alerts and restore the banner (removed in 1.5.2) drawn from the shared weather_alert control.

features.apple: Notifications for severe weather, precipitation starting, rain tomorrow (per-location setting)
features.note: The app posts nothing.
features.wire: Post shell notifications from the 15-minute refresh (weather.rs:112) when an alert or next-hour rain appears and add a per-place Notifications switch in the Locations page.

features.apple: Weather > Settings: Temperature Units Celsius or Fahrenheit, with wind and distance following
features.note: C and F switch; wind and map scale follow it.

features.apple: Updates in the background and keeps the last forecast offline
features.note: 15-minute refresh, disk cache, offline state and retry when the network path returns (services.rs:51).

features.apple: Weather widgets for desktop and Notification Centre
features.note: Current-conditions timeline entries pushed to the shell.

features.apple: Weather data attribution link
features.note: Footer credits the data service with its terms link.

features.apple: weather: URL scheme, user activities WeatherIntent and handoff
features.note: No URL handler or activity registered.
features.wire: Declare a weather:// scheme in manifest.toml and handle open requests in main.rs (main.rs:180) selecting or adding the place named in the URL.

features.apple: Share forecast, Weather intent for assistants and shortcuts
features.note: No sharing and no control methods.
features.wire: Expose current(place) and forecast(place) as app control methods (bifrost-app-control) so Shortcuts and the assistant read them, and add a Share button to the toolbar.

features.apple: Not part of the reference Weather app
features.note: BifrOSt extra kept beside the forecast; not scored.
